maria (release-ops): Quick broadcast — planned accelerated cutover this Thu 02:00-06:00 UTC. We're instituting a soft release freeze for non-security releases from 01:30-06:30 UTC to reduce blast radius while we migrate the KV/prefix cache shards. Please read below and ack if you own a rollout lane. :loud_sound:

devin (eng-runtime): Acked for runtime. We'll pause any model infra deploys and disable autoscale bursts for that window.

ankur (eng-platform): Noted. Platform will cordon new dedicated pools and pause terraform applies 01:00-07:00 UTC. Any infra migrations must be cutover outside that window or get an exception.

sophia (eng-sre): Oncall will stage additional tracing and retain 48h of cold traces for 1 week after. Ops will run preflight health checks at -6h and -1h.

kevin (product): Heads-up: feature flags for gated rollouts should be toggled to manual so we don't accidentally push during the freeze. Product will coordinate with PMs.

maria (release-ops): Canary plan: 3 waves, 10m spacing, 2% -> 20% -> 100% traffic. Rollback threshold: >3 errors/min OR latency p50 > 2x baseline for 5 consecutive minutes. If that hits, rollback to last stable and escalate.

release-bot: DEPLOYMENT SCHEDULED: canary-migration-v1 at 02:15 UTC (initiated by maria).

devin (eng-runtime): Small note: KV migration has a transient desync risk for long-running sessions. We'll enable prefix-cache read-through fallback to avoid 5xx.

ops-oncall: I'll be on-call for the window and will take PagerDuty for any P1s. Please @ops-oncall in threads with clear reproduction steps.

maria (release-ops): Exception process: if you need to lift the freeze for a hotfix, file a freeze-exception in the release tracker with owner, rollback plan, and TG (test group) approval. Release leads will triage.

ankur (eng-platform): Quick command to check canary target groups before cutover:

```
rgctl list --env prod --group canary-migration-v1
rgctl health --group canary-migration-v1
```

sophia (eng-sre): Preflight checklist (short):
- smoke test pass on canary image
- latency regressions measured vs baseline
- tracing keys emitted
- alert runbook link posted

maria (release-ops): Posting runbook and exception form here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-shard-cutover and https://redwood.internal/release-exceptions

devin (eng-runtime): FYI: We'll also pin model variant config to avoid on-the-fly quantization changes during the window.

kevin (product): Are we okay to proceed with the client-facing banner post-cutover? I can draft it but want confirmation we won't need to extend the freeze.

maria (release-ops): Please hold banner until we announce post-cutover. If everything is green we'll publish a brief status note at +1h.

ops-oncall: Confirmed I'll post the status note and move to incident channel if anything degrades.

devin (eng-runtime): Quick ask: can teams with emergency hotfixes ping me directly in DMs and cc @maria? We'll triage exceptions fast.

maria (release-ops): Yes — DM + cc here. Final reminder: freeze window 01:30-06:30 UTC Thu. Canary start 02:15 UTC. Read runbook, check preflight, and ack in this thread if you have rollout ownership. :white_check_mark:
